narrative.overview: Operate mode. Quiet reading-room aesthetic: ivory paper, ink typography, moss green actions, terracotta emphasis. Spacious working canvas beside a narrow navigation rail. Main task dominates; secondary information uses ruled lists. Serif headings, sans-serif interface, tabular timer. No decorative illustrations. Responsive single column on small screens. Focus mode removes secondary navigation visually. Visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.
